process_model.scope: all-sector GPEDC largest-intervention sample; no sector imputation

observations.ownership: k=1/0 explicitly reported objective source, n=1; conflicts/empty remain missing

process_model.observation: K[p,j] ~ Binomial(N[p,j],q[p,j]); ownership reduces to Bernoulli
process_model.hyper_estimation: maximum marginal likelihood, normal Gauss-Hermite quadrature; no manually scored input
process_model.score: C_process[g] = (100/3) * sum_j E[sigmoid(theta[g,j]) | observations and fitted hyperparameters]
process_model.unobserved_components: no total; prior-only estimates never promoted to observed scores
process_model.interval: Bonferroni union bound of marginal posterior intervals conditional on fitted hyperparameters
process_model.weights: 1/3 inherited GPEDC three-component balance; not objectively optimal or learned social values

output_model.eligibility: closed single-recipient activities, past observation period, one numeric target and actual, target>0, forecast labels excluded
output_model.binary_measure: Y[p,j] = 1(actual[p,j] >= target[p,j]); target>=actual is not defined as a causal benefit
output_model.linear_predictor: logit Pr(Y[p,j]=1) = beta0 + u[recipient,sector] + v[indicator,unit] + a[project]
output_model.common_items: exact source indicator title and unit shared by >=2 recipient countries within a sector; connected graph required
output_model.standardization: C_output[g] = (100/J) * sum_j E_posterior E_a [sigmoid(beta0+u[g]+v[j]+a)] over fixed sector-specific common basket
output_model.estimation: penalized likelihood with project-level nested holdout penalty selection; Laplace approximation for conditional uncertainty
output_model.validation_gate: all three pilot sectors failed to beat pooled baseline in nested holdout; not recommended for public rank

legacy_four_pillar_formula.status: not used by automatic prototypes; has no common objective inputs for all four dimensions

country_grade_combination: display separately; GPEDC inputs overlap with country grades, so do not add as independent evidence
